atp_singles_data <- readRDS(file = here::here("data", "processed", "atp_singles.Rds"))


source(here::here("ranking_timeline.R"))

I chose to change the legends and annotations for my graph containing a trendline of the ATP singles ranking for Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz. To start, I put the legend below the graph with larger points to help the audience view it easier. For the annotations, I created a tibble with the dates and labels I wanted for each player's grand slam win. This helped automate the labeling process, which I used geom_point and geom_text_repel for. I used the ggrepel library to ensure that the text from the label does not block any of the points.
